summary: Phase 1 completed: KampComposition.lean with sorry-free infrastructure (7 theorems verified with lean_verify). Phase 2 blocked: general same-depth composition on non-constant envs is not provable without Prior-UZ/SZ temporal formula access, creating circular dependency with ExistPart. The Until/Since backward sorries require direct formula enrichment, not a composition theorem. Plan v5 Phase 2 should be SKIPPED.
blockers: Phase 2 BLOCKED: General same-depth composition on non-constant envs has order-gap problem (counterexample NfComposition.lean:20-36). nf_extend_fwd from different base elements gives different witnesses with incompatible order relations.

Phase 3 requires reformulation: Until/Since backward sorries need formula enrichment encoding 3-var existential conditions as temporal formulas. ih_exist only handles constant-parent envs but Until zone has [x,t] non-constant parent. Need either: (a) new ih_exist variant for 2-element parents, (b) reduction to constant-parent via constenv infrastructure, or (c) VecEA2 bracket generalization to k>0.

continuation_context.key_insight: The general composition theorem is the WRONG approach for closing the sorry. The correct approach is formula enrichment. The eq zone already works with ih_exist on constant envs. Until/Since zones need the same approach but with non-constant parent env [x,t]. The fundamental question is: can the 3-var existential conditions (exists y, nf_eval M (k'+1) 3 [y,x,t] ssn) be encoded as temporal formulas at t, given that ih_exist only handles constant parent (fun _ => t)?

Key finding: The composition approach (1-var => 2-var on non-constant envs) is mathematically correct on Prior structures but requires Prior-UZ/SZ at the NF level, which creates a circular dependency with ExistPart
